items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: When is it that you do this rehearsal with Red Norvo and Mildred Bailey? ... We were rehearsing for something together.

ctx.x: Yeah. When is it that you do this rehearsal with Red Norvo and Mildred Bailey? You did that at the Empire Ballroom.

Right. We did that, and I don't think it ever worked out. We were rehearsing for something together. And I remember going there... I don't know if it was before I left Rex or after I left Rex, when I worked there at the Onyx Club with him.
